notes:
Summary: mid-market multi-tenant conversational platform (SaaS) exploring Redwood as inference backend. Primary motive: stabilize streaming SLOs and add per-tenant rate/quotas + predictable cost for customers. Started with Hosted API POC; moving toward Dedicated for predictable p95/p99 and to isolate noisy tenants.

POC highlights (hosted API):
- POC window: 2026-01-10 -> 2026-01-29 (3-week workload run).
- Workload: ~120 live tenant sims, 800 reqs/min aggregate, mix of short-turn chat and longer tool-calling flows (DB lookup, HTTP enrich).
- Observed metrics: median streaming token latency ~110-140ms; p95 ~320ms; p99 spikes to 600-1200ms when concurrent tool calls fire.
- Failure modes: streaming disconnects after long-running tool calls (~60-90m into sustained run), smaller tenants hit throttling when one tenant bursts.
- Models tested: redwood-2-small & open-llama-7b (quantized). Copperbridge prefers smaller models for cost but wants fallback to larger model for complex tool flows.

Security & compliance:
- SSO/SAML required for admin console.
- Need audit logs for tenant-level requests and retention policy configurable per customer.
- Data residency for EU customers (some tenancy in eu-west). KMS integration required for encryption of keys.

Customer quotes & persona notes:
- CTO (Evan Park): "We can tolerate slightly higher median latency, but tail behavior during tool-calls is a dealbreaker — customers expect streaming continuity."
- Head of Platform (Rina Gupta): cares about per-tenant quotas, burst protection, and cost allocation by tenant.

Commercial:
- Interested in a Dedicated reserved pool (initial ask: 2-4 A100-equivalent GPUs) to guarantee throughput. Asking for committed throughput & burst pricing.
- Sensitive to per-token price for high volume tenants and to predictable monthly cap per-tenant.
- Asked for a simple addendum for Dedicated with baseline SLA and failover to Hosted when capacity constrained.

Recent touches / timeline:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE Maya), demo of hosted API streaming + tool-calling (notes in Drive).
- 2026-01-20: Engineering sync (SE Diego) — instrumented latency collection + sample traces (linked INF-4218).
- 2026-01-29: End of hosted POC; internal summary doc uploaded. Noted streaming disconnects under sustained load.
- 2026-02-02: Security questionnaire submitted; Redwood answered most items, left residency/KMS follow-ups (ticket SEC-3391).
- 2026-02-10: Pricing ask submitted for Dedicated (attached pricing-draft_v2).
- 2026-02-12: AE and SE debrief — agreed next step: staged Dedicated POC (canary) with per-tenant quotas and extended streaming test (48h).

Next steps (short):
- Schedule Dedicated pricing deep-dive (AE + sales engineering + infra) — target week of 2026-02-20.
- SE to provision canary Dedicated pool and run 48h sustained test simulating 300 tenants with configurable quotas.
- Security team to finalize KMS/residency answers and produce final addendum.

Notes style: bullets / shorthand; follow-ups owned by Maya (AE) and Diego (SE).
